name: watchermcp
description: Evidence-first hardware remediation and Redfish verification MCP servers split across three read-only trust zones (fleet, records, market).

tools.name: fleet.get_observations
tools.description: Read normalized telemetry receipts filtered optionally by asset_id.

tools.name: records.get_cases
tools.description: Read durable hardware anomaly case summaries filtered optionally by asset_id.

tools.name: records.get_plans
tools.description: Read proposed maintenance plans filtered optionally by case_id.

tools.name: market.get_tenders
tools.description: Read simulation tender records: discovery long-lists, scored shortlists, and bid comparisons.
